QUOTE: If it is the current channel, kick the user out with `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`; then remove the user from the channel | After the server call, set `delete_at` to now and keep the channel
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when archived channels aren't viewable the user is removed from the channel (and kicked out if it is the current channel). When viewable, the channel is kept and `delete_at` is set, which is the "marked deleted" part.
